sample_texts: A chat bubble that can use your phone for you.
"Reply to Sam that I'm late", "add milk to my basket".
Your own plan, no API key
Runs Claude Code from your Claude subscription. Codex with a ChatGPT plan, Antigravity with a Google account, Grok with a Google or X account and OpenCode's free models work too.
Sending, posting, buying and deleting always ask first.
Who answers your chats. You can add others later in Settings.
Uses your Claude subscription (Pro or Max).
No account needed. Connect your own providers later.
Buddy's accessibility service shows the bubble and lets the agent read the screen, tap and type, only when you ask it to do something.
Nothing leaves the phone except what Claude Code sends to Anthropic to answer you. Sending, posting, buying and deleting always ask for your OK first.
In the list: Downloaded apps → Buddy assistant → turn it on.
Buddy uses Android's accessibility service to do what you ask in other apps: it reads what's on the screen and taps, types and scrolls for you. It also shows the floating bubble.

While a task runs, the screen content, which can include personal information such as messages, names or addresses, is sent to the AI service of the agent you choose (Anthropic for Claude Code, OpenAI for Codex, Google for Antigravity, xAI for Grok, or your OpenCode model's provider), only to carry out your request.
Buddy has no servers of its own. It doesn't collect, sell or share this data, and doesn't use it for ads.
Before anything that sends, posts, buys or deletes, Buddy asks for your OK. You can turn the service off anytime in Android's accessibility settings.

Shows the Buddy chat bubble and lets the agent you choose (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Antigravity or Grok), running inside Buddy on this phone, read the screen and tap, type and scroll for you. Nothing leaves the phone except what the agent itself sends to its AI service (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, xAI or your OpenCode model's provider).
Allow Buddy assistant to have full control of your device?
Full control is appropriate for apps that help you with accessibility needs, but not for most apps.
It can read all content on the screen and display content over other apps.
It can track your interactions with an app or a hardware sensor, and interact with apps on your behalf.

app_chain_summary_zh: 该应用以「聊天泡泡替你操作手机」为卖点，经六步引导（选代理→应用内隐私同意弹层）把用户引至系统无障碍设置，最终弹出「完全控制设备」的系统高危授权警告；拒绝授权后返回应用仍停在第2步，并反复重新拉起诱导弹层施压。
observed_lure_rhetoric_zh: 英文 -> 「认识Buddy：一个能替你操作手机的聊天泡泡」（引导首屏）
英文 -> 「用大白话下指令即可，如『回复Sam说我迟到了』『把牛奶加进购物车』」（引导首屏）
英文 -> 「用你自己的订阅，无需 API Key」（引导首屏）
英文 -> 「你始终掌控：发送、发帖、购买、删除前都会先询问」（引导首屏、第2步）
英文 -> 「除所选代理发给AI服务商的内容外，其他都不离开手机」（第2步、服务详情页）
英文 -> 「Buddy没有自己的服务器，不收集、不出售、不共享这些数据，也不用于广告」（应用内隐私同意弹层）
英文 -> 「设置大约只需5分钟」（引导首屏，降低心理门槛）
英文 -> 「OpenCode：免费·限量」（第1步，低价诱饵选项）

frame_captions_zh.step_01: 引导首屏介绍「Meet Buddy」聊天泡泡可代你操作手机，强调用现有订阅无需API Key、敏感操作前会询问；点击「Get started」进入六步向导。
frame_captions_zh.step_02: 向导第1步「选择代理」，列出Claude Code（推荐）、Codex、OpenCode（免费限量）三张卡片；保留默认代理后点击「Continue」进入下一步。
frame_captions_zh.step_03: 向导第2步索取无障碍权限，称仅在用户要求时读屏、点击、输入，数据只发给所选AI；点击「Open accessibility settings」跳转系统设置。
frame_captions_zh.step_04: 应用内隐私同意弹层，说明读屏代操作、屏幕内容含个人信息将发往第三方AI、无自有服务器；点击「Agree and continue」进入系统无障碍列表。
frame_captions_zh.step_05: 跳至系统无障碍设置页，「已下载应用」中Buddy assistant显示为关闭；探针在此捕获无障碍页钩子后自动终止，尚未真正授权。
frame_captions_zh.post_jump_0.8s: 跳转后0.8秒探针：仍停留系统无障碍设置列表页，无弹窗、无遮罩，未出现二次引导或跳回应用。
frame_captions_zh.post_jump_2.0s: 跳转后2.0秒探针：仍在系统无障碍列表页，遮罩数为0，页面文本为空，未出现系统警告或诱导覆盖层。
frame_captions_zh.detail_1_service_detail_page: 无障碍服务详情页：显示「使用Buddy assistant」开关与快捷键选项，长文描述读屏代操作及数据仅发往所选AI服务商；本步仅查看未开启。
frame_captions_zh.detail_2_system_warning_dialog: 系统原生高危警告弹窗：询问是否允许完全控制设备，列明可读取全部屏幕、覆盖显示、代替用户操作等风险，含「允许/拒绝」；仅查看未授权。
frame_captions_zh.refusal_2.0s: 拒绝授权返回后2秒：应用仍停在第2步无障碍引导页，并再次自动拉起同类诱导弹层（RELAUNCHED_LURE_DIALOG），持续施压。
frame_captions_zh.refusal_10.5s: 拒权后10.5秒：再次回到同一无障碍引导页并重新拉起诱导弹层，未提供有效降级或放弃路径，形成循环引导。
